_说明: 非人声音效：key → public/audio/sfx/<key>/，n 是变体条数，d 是秒数，text 是给 ElevenLabs 的英文描述，loop 做成无缝循环（环境音）。触发规则见 src/lib/audio/cues.ts

amb_blizzard.text: Muffled blizzard howling outside an old wooden mountain lodge, heard from indoors, wind buffeting the shutters, constant and cold, no music

amb_night.text: Night inside an old timber lodge during a snowstorm, distant low howling wind, creaking wooden beams settling, eerie stillness, no music

amb_fire.text: A pale ghostly fire burning in a stone hearth, soft unnatural crackle with a faint cold eerie hum, no warmth, no music

stone.text: A small smooth stone placed firmly on a heavy oak table, single solid knock, quiet room

pyre.text: A pale ghostly flame suddenly roaring up from a hearth, eerie whoosh with a low ethereal choir-like hum, horror

heartbeat.text: Slow heavy human heartbeat, deep muffled thumps, tense horror atmosphere

door.text: Old heavy wooden door creaking open slowly in a cold empty lodge corridor

bolt.text: Heavy iron door bolt sliding shut, rusty metallic clunk, old wooden door

body.text: A body collapsing onto an old wooden floor, dull heavy thud, horror

gust.text: Sudden violent gust of blizzard wind slamming against old windows, wooden shutters rattling, mountain lodge at night

bell.text: A single low cracked bronze bell toll echoing through a snowy mountain pass at dawn, distant and mournful

howl.text: A lone wolf howling far away across a snowy mountain pass at night, wind carrying it, eerie and cold

clock.text: An old grandfather clock striking midnight in a silent wooden lodge, slow deep chimes, ominous

listen.text: Eerie glass harmonica shimmer with a faint distant heartbeat, someone listening to a soul, supernatural, quiet

steps.text: Slow careful footsteps on old creaking wooden floorboards in a dark corridor at night

ash.text: Cold embers and ash crumbling in a dead hearth, a soft dry hiss and a faint ghostly sigh

murmur.text: A tense murmur of a small crowd in a wooden hall, uneasy whispers rising, then falling silent

virtue.text: A single warm resonant bell-like chime swelling softly, resolve awakening, cold room, cinematic

vice.text: A dissonant cracking sound like ice breaking with a low distorted string swell, despair, horror sting

cooking.text: A small iron pot simmering on an old stove, spoons clinking against tin bowls, quiet voices out of focus, warm kitchen

snowslide.text: Loose snow and rocks sliding down a steep mountain edge, a rope pulled taut, heavy breathing, wind

crackle.text: A quiet hearth fire crackling softly late at night, logs settling, intimate and calm

cards.text: An old deck of playing cards being shuffled and dealt onto a wooden table

hammer.text: Hammering nails into wooden boards to repair a window, planks being dragged, wind outside

piano.text: A slow melancholic melody on an old out-of-tune upright piano in a cold empty lodge, a little reverb

prayer.text: Several people murmuring a quiet prayer together in candlelight, indistinct low voices, solemn

crates.text: Old wooden crates being pried open with a crowbar in a stone cellar, tins clattering

cupboard.text: An old wooden pantry cupboard creaking open, empty shelves, a tin rolling, someone gasps

argument.text: A heated argument between several people heard through a wooden wall, muffled indistinct shouting, a fist hitting a table

whispers.text: Soft hushed whispering of a few people in a quiet dark room, gossip spreading, close and intimate, low volume, unsettling

dream.text: A hazy dreamlike swell, distant bells under water, soft reversed wind, eerie and surreal

fire_whisper.text: Low ghostly whispering voices rising out of a pale crackling fire in a dark stone cellar, breathy, wordless, cold and supernatural, close to the ear, no music

brand.text: Red-hot iron brand pressed onto skin, sharp sizzling hiss of burning flesh, short and intense, no screaming, no music

slam.text: Fist slamming down hard on a heavy oak table in a large wooden hall, single loud thud, cups rattling, no music

chair.text: Heavy wooden chair dragged across a stone floor, then someone sits down heavily, creak, quiet hall, no music
